roadmap.title: SDE Master Roadmap
roadmap.target: Software Development Engineer / Product Company SDE
roadmap.description: A structured, checklist-driven roadmap covering DSA, CS fundamentals, frontend, backend, databases, infrastructure, system design, projects and interview preparation.

weekly: Take one timed DSA session after the foundation period
rules: Prefer problem solving and implementation over passive video watching.
Do not mark a topic complete until you can explain it without notes.
For DSA, record pattern, approach, complexity and common mistakes.
Revisit weak topics using spaced repetition.
Start interview preparation early instead of waiting until the roadmap is finished.

phases.title: Setup & Baseline
phases.objective: Create the tracking system, establish a baseline and prepare the study environment.

tasks.title: Set a fixed 3-4 hour daily study window
Explain both resume projects without notes
Record weak areas for later revision

phases.title: DSA Foundation
phases.objective: Build strong problem-solving fundamentals and master linear data structures.

tasks.title: Understand Big O, Omega and Theta
Practice complexity analysis on common algorithms
Queue using stacks and stack using queues

phases.title: Core DSA
phases.objective: Master hashing, binary search and tree-based data structures.

phases.title: Advanced DSA
phases.objective: Develop graph, recursion, greedy and dynamic-programming problem-solving ability.

phases.title: C++ & OOP
phases.objective: Become comfortable explaining C++ memory, STL and object-oriented design.

phases.title: JavaScript Deep Dive
phases.objective: Understand JavaScript internals deeply enough for frontend and full-stack interviews.

phases.title: TypeScript
phases.objective: Use TypeScript confidently in React and Node applications.

tasks.title: Enums and when to avoid them

phases.title: React & Frontend Engineering
phases.objective: Master React behavior, performance, state management and practical frontend architecture.

phases.title: Node.js & Express
phases.objective: Understand Node internals and build maintainable production-style APIs.

phases.title: HTTP, REST APIs & Authentication
phases.objective: Design secure, predictable APIs and explain modern web authentication.

phases.title: SQL, DBMS & PostgreSQL
phases.objective: Build strong database fundamentals, query skills and PostgreSQL performance knowledge.

phases.title: MongoDB
phases.objective: Understand document modeling and when MongoDB is appropriate compared with relational databases.

phases.title: Computer Networks
phases.objective: Understand how a request travels from a client to a server and back.

phases.title: Operating Systems
phases.objective: Understand processes, threads, scheduling, memory, synchronization and file systems.

tasks.title: Stack vs heap from OS perspective

phases.title: Linux & Git
phases.objective: Operate comfortably in a Linux development environment and use Git professionally.

tasks.title: Working tree, staging area and commits
Pull requests and code review workflow

phases.title: Docker, CI/CD & Deployment
phases.objective: Containerize applications and understand the path from code commit to production deployment.

phases.title: Redis
phases.objective: Use Redis correctly for caching, sessions, rate limiting and distributed application patterns.

phases.title: Low-Level Design
phases.objective: Translate requirements into maintainable classes, interfaces and extensible object-oriented designs.

tasks.title: Design a notification system at class level

phases.title: High-Level Design Foundations
phases.objective: Understand the building blocks and trade-offs used in scalable distributed systems.

phases.title: System Design Practice
phases.objective: Apply the HLD framework repeatedly to common interview systems.

tasks.title: Add cache and queues where appropriate

phases.title: Production Engineering
phases.objective: Close the gap between interview knowledge and production-quality engineering.

phases.title: Enterprise E-Commerce Project
phases.objective: Build a production-style flagship full-stack application demonstrating SDE-level engineering.

tasks.title: Use database transactions for critical flows

phases.title: Pharmacy Management Project
phases.objective: Make the existing production project interview-ready and demonstrate ownership of real business software.

phases.title: Interview Preparation & Mocks
phases.objective: Convert knowledge into interview performance and become capable of defending the resume under pressure.

tasks.title: Practice explaining brute force before optimization
State time and space complexity for every solution
Keep resume to one page where practical
Quantify impact only with truthful metrics

dsa: Re-solve weak problems without looking at solutions
